dedupe_keys.name: hrsa area health resources files ahrf county state and national health resource data

description: The Area Health Resources Files are a large compilation of health resource indicators for every county in the United States, together with state and national totals. The Health Resources and Services Administration's Bureau of Health Workforce assembles them each year from more than 50 sources, including the American Medical Association, the American Hospital Association, CMS and the Census Bureau. The files carry current and historic data for more than 6,000 variables per county on health care professions (physicians by specialty, nurses, dentists, physician assistants), health facilities (hospitals, beds, nursing homes, health centres), hospital utilisation and expenditure, health professions training, population characteristics, economics and environment, with a data year given for each variable. The data are free to download as county-level and state-level files with technical documentation; parts that come from licensed sources carry use conditions noted in the documentation. Caveats: variables are updated on different cycles, so a single release mixes data years, county boundaries change over time, and the facility counts are aggregates with no locations. Simulation uses: describing county-level health system capacity for surge and capacity planning models, estimating workforce and bed shortfalls under hazard scenarios, and building social vulnerability layers for healthcare access analysis. Related records: HRSA's health workforce projections (data-hrsa-health-workforce-projections) extend the workforce side, and the AHRQ HCUP databases (data-ahrq-hcup-hospital-utilization-databases) give hospital utilisation detail.
